lessons.text: When a user-visible literal string is specified in both spec.md and design.md, pin it with a literal assertion in a test and name one document canonical. Here the hook emitted the spec.md wording while design.md:222 carried an extra 'pnpm ' prefix; only the test naming its source (pending-advisories.test.mjs:30-33) made the drift decidable instead of a coin flip between two docs.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::a ci job that re implements a per commit git hook must iterate the pr s commits not collapse the range reproducing the commit msg check with git reset soft base plus git log 1 head judges the whole pr diff against a single message so any escape hatch trailer on the head commit exempts every commit in the pr faithful for the file half weaker for the message half
lessons.text: A CI job that re-implements a per-commit git hook must iterate the PR's commits, not collapse the range. Reproducing the commit-msg check with 'git reset --soft base' plus 'git log -1 head' judges the whole PR diff against a single message, so any escape-hatch trailer on the head commit exempts every commit in the PR. Faithful for the file half, weaker for the message half.
